verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is an AML screening, monitoring and case-management platform that sits in onboarding flows, so onboarding funnel analytics is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence pack documents no verification funnel analytics: no pass rates, drop-off points, or completion times broken down by country or document type. The only related item is the ability to export CUSTOMER_SCREENING data by date range, which is a raw-data building block for building analytics yourself, not the analytics capability itself, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As a founder, I can see verification funnel analytics — pass rates, drop-off points, completion time by country and document type — to know what verification is costing me in signups
